evaluation_mode: small-sample fresh-context comparison of the prior and current skill; qualitative, not a statistical benchmark

evals.name: vague-target-architecture
evals.prompt: Create an AWS architecture for my online store.
evals.expected_output: Review for missing current-state versus target-state, audience/detail, known service choices, and material requirements. Ask no more than three focused questions before drawing if an unresolved choice would materially change the view. After clarification, present a concise plan and proceed with the requested diagram; label optional unknowns as assumptions.

evals.name: scoped-conceptual-three-tier
evals.prompt: Create a conceptual AWS three-tier architecture for an online store. Show customers, public entry, web, application, and database tiers with labeled request/response flows. Choose sensible services and mark every unspecified service or placement as an assumption. Save editable HTML/SVG and an evidence note.
evals.expected_output: Do not delay with questions already answered by the prompt. Give a brief plan, proceed, distinguish required elements from assumed service choices, and apply visual QA to the rendered diagram.

evals.name: code-grounded-current-state
evals.prompt: Inspect the supplied checkout service source and tests. Create a current-state component and interaction diagram. Do not propose a redesign.
evals.expected_output: Inspect actual source and tests; represent the order as inventory reservation, payment authorization, order persistence, and OrderPlaced publication. Show the rejection/compensation behavior supported by the tests. Cite file/line evidence and mark unknown protocols/runtime/deployment as unknown; do not invent a target design.

evals.name: customer-facing-sensitive-data-handoff
evals.prompt: Prepare a customer-facing data-flow diagram for the fictional payment service described in the supplied source brief. Show trust boundaries, storage, and operational paths. Keep unknown controls visible as gaps.
evals.expected_output: Use the supplied fictional evidence and cite it. Label customer ID as personal data and payment token/amount as payment-related data without inventing values. Show only the two evidenced HTTPS connections; do not imply other controls. Include relevant security/privacy/reliability/operations review gaps, owner roles, draft status, assumptions, and avoid claiming compliance or approval.
